issues: No cheating found. The change only alters how the training labels inside fit_predict are transformed: the scaled ranks become rank-based inverse-normal scores, ppf((rank-0.5)/n). It does not read files, paste in answers or use test labels.
No bug. (rank-0.5)/n always stays strictly between 0 and 1, even with ties, so norm.ppf always returns finite numbers. The output stays monotone with the target, which is all Spearman scoring needs.
